about_description: Hello! I am a passionate Web Developer who loves turning ideas into functional and visually engaging digital experiences. Over the past years, I have worked with a wide range of technologies including JavaScript, React, and Next.js, constantly learning and improving my craft. I have also explored the Web3 and blockchain ecosystem — integrating crypto payments and decentralized features into real-world applications. What drives me is the opportunity to create something meaningful.
web3_description: Discover San Luis like never before with our Web3-powered tourism platform. Enjoy seamless digital payments, blockchain security, and wallet integration while exploring top destinations. A modern way to plan, book, and experience travel!
chat_description: Join our live chat project built with Next.js and backend tech — chat in real time with others on the same server!

sanluis.title: Web3 Tourism Project
sanluis.description: Visita San Luis Antioquia is an innovative tourism project designed to promote the attractions of San Luis, Antioquia. It integrates Web3 technologies for secure blockchain payments.

chat.title: Chat Live App
chat.description: Chat Live is a real-time messaging platform built with Next.js and WebSocket technology, allowing users to chat instantly in shared rooms.
